ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The app uses the camera to take photos for your messages and to scan pairing codes (QR).
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The app uses the microphone so you can dictate messages. The recording is only used for speech recognition.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: The app uses your device's speech recognition to turn dictation into text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: The app needs access to your photos to attach images to messages.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: The app saves images from the chat to your photo library when you choose Save Image.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: The app adds events to your calendar when you confirm it in the chat.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: The app adds events to your calendar when you confirm it in the chat.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The app connects to your Hermes server or bridge on your local network.
